title: Quantum Optimisation for Transport Vulnerability Identification
summary: Transport network vulnerability analysis plays a crucial role in safeguarding urban resilience. Traditional vulnerability identification approaches have provided valuable insights, yet they face two major limitations. First, the number of disruption scenarios increases combinatorially with the number of disrupted links considered simultaneously, making classical approaches computationally prohibitive.
